title: PutBlobResponse
description: Source of truth: BlobStore filesystem (SHA256-keyed, Category C operational) and IrohBlobStore filesystem (BLAKE3-keyed, Category C operational). Response from PUT /blob/{hash}. Returns the SHA256-keyed shard manifest (legacy wire-compat) and, when the iroh blob store is configured server-side, the BLAKE3 hash the bytes were also written under.

blake3Hash.description: BLAKE3 hash the same bytes were written to in IrohBlobStore. Null when iroh side is not configured or the iroh write failed (legacy SHA256 write still succeeded in that case).
